messages:
nolan_fin: Reconciliation alerted: 15 invoices/refunds mismatch this morning, total exposure ~$2,700. Stripe shows events delivered but NetSuite has no corresponding credit memos for refunds and some invoices show duplicate zeroed lines. anyone on webhook team?

irene_eng: digging in relay logs. noticed a rollout last night for stricter signature verification (we started enforcing Stripe-Signature-V1 header only). a subset of older webhook deliveries used the legacy signature header and were rejected with 401s. replay later reprocessed those events but a mixed pipeline of legacy and new endpoints caused duplicates for some idempotent flows.

sam_sre: infra confirms many 401s between 23:40-23:55 UTC. webhook-bot shows retries after secret rotation but our relay acked some events before downstream durable write was completed, so the replay created duplicate apply attempts.

webhook-bot: Alert: rejected webhook count 23 (signature-mismatch) window 23:41-23:56 UTC.

nolan_fin: impact: 15 customers affected; 9 missing refund credit memos (~$1,900) and 6 invoices with duplicated merge behavior that zeroed line items (~$800 misapplied). Collections already flagged two accounts. finance needs CSV of stripe_event_id, stripe_refund_or_invoice_id, customer_email, amount, ns_id (if any). Also approval to issue manual credits to clear customer-facing issues.

irene_eng: root cause: secret rotation script updated endpoints to expect the new signature header but didn't keep a permissive fallback for the older header. when the relay rejected the legacy-signed events they ended up in a delayed replay that collided with subsequent legitimately delivered events.

sam_sre: mitigation applied: rolled back strict-only check to accept both v0 and v1 signatures for 30 minutes and enabled durable write-before-ack on the relay. quarantined suspect replay batches and enabled duplicate-event alerts.

tara_ops: approve manual credits up to $3k to expedite customer fixes. require audit comment "signature-rotation-replay" on manual adjustments. :white_check_mark:

irene_eng: plan: 1) produce CSV and drop at /shared/finance/webhook-signing/2291234567-affected.csv 2) run a dry-run backfill using event.id dedupe to generate a staging table for finance 3) after finance signoff, apply corrections and mark audit tags. ETA 3 hours for CSV + dry-run.

nolan_fin: please prepend collection-hold instructions in CSV and cc finance-ops in the ticket. will review dry-run and authorize apply. keep thread terse.

irene_eng: sample signature check we used to repro: ```python
# permissive verification
def verify(sig_header, payload, secrets):
  for s in secrets:
    try:
      stripe.Webhook.construct_event(payload, sig_header, s)
      return True
    except stripe.error.SignatureVerificationError:
      continue
  return False
```

irene_eng: uploaded CSV to /shared/finance/webhook-signing/2291234567-affected.csv (fields: stripe_event_id, stripe_object_id, customer_email, amount, ns_invoice_id, note). starting dry-run now.

sam_sre: adding alert: if signature-rejects > 1% in any 5m window post-rollback, page oncall.

nolan_fin: thanks all. will review the CSV and reply with approval or questions.
